BiblicalUsage: Channathon is a place in Palestine, named once, as a border town of Zebulun, where the border compassed to it and turned toward the north. Joshua draws the line of Zebulun past it on the way to the valley of Jiphthah-el.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe even a border town named once belongs on the map God drew, because the inheritance was measured town by town.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
